Explicit structural revision limited to the reviewed composition defects; preserveRequirements=true. Preserve all six accepted requirements and their exact public input/output contracts, the existing requested workbook path, maximum ten first listed products in observed order, actual search and individual product visits, real structured writing and always cleanup. Do not add ranking, sponsored filtering, deduplication or other goals/actions. Keep the bounded query-to-URL conversion.

Remove accept_cookies_if_present: it is unrequested and is unconditional despite its objective. Remove the duplicate read used only after that removed action; reuse the initial complete acquisition. Preserve truthful failures, with completeness guards referencing actual original producer metadata, not declared success flags. Do not claim a click can silently skip an absent control.

Rebuild only data adaptation using existing bindings. For each complete observationSnapshot.pages collection, retain original typed record arrays with the minimal necessary foreach projection (field(item,"records") in that scope), then flatten exactly one level. Do not learn copying of typed records. Bind extraction input named pages to the actual pages collection and declare each:{input:"pages",output:"rows"}; resultType describes the complete assembled object, rows:array<array<Candidate>>. Every page contributes one compact candidate array. Candidates contain an unchanged observed reference as identity and only complete observed text/facts required by the immediate decision. Keep original href/URL/reference/actions separately; do not shorten IDs or invent positions. Process all complete pages. No field access on arrays. Interpret only flattened compact candidate arrays, never a snapshot or originals alongside them. Selection returns unchanged candidate IDs only (at most first ten product IDs in observed order), without filtering sponsored products or deduplicating. Before action, validate selected IDs against offered candidates using strict lookup, then reconnect those same IDs against original observed records for exact navigation arguments. Preserve repetitions. Fold offered validation into ordered local requires where equivalent.

Within each product visit, repeat bounded page extraction and compact ID selection for relevant name, description, price and actual error blocks. Copy one complete observed description block verbatim; do not summarize/rewrite/concatenate it. Interface affordances (e.g. report-a-problem controls) are not error evidence. Nullable missing IDs must be guarded before lookup. Lookup returns an array even for a singleton: use the existing bounded singleton scope to project original text in the non-null branch; export permitted nulls in the other branch with matching typed outputs. Validate IDs against offered candidates before original lookup. A complete observed value stays exact; no unrelated fallback values, generated absence prose or invented data. Keep non-null product records with the accepted nullable fields.

Remove assemble_excel_rows interpretation and all inference for typed copying, ID reconnection, row assembly or completion status. Use existing direct bindings, necessary captures, scope exports and bounded projections to assemble products and productRows. Keep necessary intermediate/cardinality checks and failure ordering. Bind structured writer rows as flatten([[headerRow], productRows]) with the explicit supplied headerRow ["name","description","price","error"] and each product row in that same order. Nulls are blank cells, whitespace and strings remain exact, repetitions remain ordered. Preserve the accepted products maxItems:10 via a real typed contract/bounded projection, not prose. Return xlsx_path from the successful writer's actual declared output. Derive truthful completion_status with existing typed/local predicates and explicit branches if needed, never inference or a literal substituted for work.

Use existing TaskPlan vocabulary and authoritative operation contracts only. Preserve v10 compilation, schemas, permissions, inference/resource limits, cleanup and unrelated business work. Necessary data-adaptation task insertion/removal is authorized for this revision; no change to accepted requirements or external goals.
